statements.impact_statement: GHSA-j6qf-3m9c-vwj3: ClientIPFromXFF in github.com/go-chi/chi/v5/middleware (client_ip.go) accepts X-Forwarded-For entries without checking the direct peer. It was added in chi 5.3.0 and fixed in 5.4.0 by https://github.com/go-chi/chi/commit/7f9b7448f51d28804fac98c0a17bc2a7cec1079f. We read the build information (go version -m) and the symbol table of /usr/bin/trivy in every published trivy-dev build, 0.69.1-r0 through 0.74.0-r11 (37 builds each on x86_64 and aarch64). Each build installs 1 statically linked Go program, /usr/bin/trivy, for Linux. Builds 0.69.1-r0 to 0.71.2-r2 carry chi 5.2.4 or 5.2.5, which have no client_ip.go. 0.71.2-r3 carries chi 5.3.0 but links neither ClientIPFromXFF nor its X-Forwarded-For helpers (walkXFF, parseHeaderAddr); only GetClientIP, which reads a value from the request context, is linked. Builds from 0.73.0-r0 do not include chi.
